name: Hilltop Tower
title: Hilltop Tower
summary: An Empyrean fortress tower south of Holtburg atop a hill, where the Hilltop portals drop; drudges and a runed chest at the top. In the kit it is a 31 m five-storey mossy spire tower (top z 202.8) on the broad summit plateau at z 172 - the highest ground for kilometres - with a drudge campfire, stone seats and a bucket at its south-west foot and a stand of 32 m pines around the summit, open only to the east.

landmarks.name: Drudge campfire
landmarks.note: Fire 0x02000485 with stone seats, a bucket and a spider-skull prop, 16 m SSW of the tower.

landmarks.name: Summit pines
landmarks.note: 32 m default-bake trees west and south of the tower (0x020002D3/0x020002DA).

site.name: Hilltop Tower
site.notes: Teleport = gazetteer hilltop (the Hilltop portal drop point 23 m north of the tower, z 171.3).

shots.standingOrder: Look straight up the sunlit south-east face of the 31 m spire tower from 0.8 m above the summit grass, 6 m off the stone, with a slow counter-roll; nothing closer than 2 m.
shots.notes: Worm's-eye: lens 0.8 m above the summit grass 13 m SE of the tower axis (6 m off the stone), looking straight up the sunlit south-east face of the 31 m spire tower with a slow -10 deg roll, the spire tip against the noon sky.
